description: This is a PHP source file for a web interface page that manages adding allowed devices, likely part of a parental control or device management system. It includes server-side scripting in PHP, HTML markup for a form with device selection options, embedded JavaScript for UI behavior and AJAX actions, and references to other included PHP files and server-side functions.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value associated with a given parameter name, likely from request parameters or configuration.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values for a specified object path and mapping array, used here to obtain device host information.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Obtains a list of instance IDs for device objects in the management system.
